title: 书信通用框架与礼貌表达
desc: 覆盖称呼、开头目的、过渡、礼貌请求、致谢致歉与结尾落款，约100词书信通用框架。

entries.en: Dear Sir or Madam,
entries.example: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to inquire about the language training programme advertised on your website.
entries.exampleZh: 尊敬的先生或女士：我写信是想咨询贵网站广告中提到的语言培训项目。
entries.note: 称呼段首行顶格写，后接逗号；不知收信人姓名时使用，结束语须配 Yours faithfully。

entries.en: Dear Mr. Wang,
entries.example: Dear Mr. Wang, I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your generous assistance.
entries.exampleZh: 尊敬的王先生：我写信是为了对您慷慨的帮助表示诚挚的感谢。
entries.note: 已知姓名用姓氏加 Mr./Ms.，后接逗号；结束语须配 Yours sincerely，不可与 faithfully 混用。

entries.en: Dear Professor Smith,
entries.example: Dear Professor Smith, I would like to seek your advice on my application for a research programme.
entries.exampleZh: 尊敬的史密斯教授：我想就我申请研究项目一事向您请教。
entries.note: 学术场景中对导师用 Professor 而非 Mr.；头衔后不加姓名缩写，正式程度高于 Dear Smith。

entries.en: To Whom It May Concern,
entries.example: To Whom It May Concern, I am writing to confirm my attendance at the conference to be held next month.
entries.exampleZh: 敬启者：我写信是为了确认出席下个月举行的会议。
entries.note: 仅用于推荐信、证明信等面向机构的正式信件；称呼词首字母均大写，后接逗号，结尾用 Yours faithfully。

entries.en: Dear All,
entries.example: Dear All, I am writing to inform you of the revised schedule for our group presentation.
entries.exampleZh: 各位好：我写信是为了告知大家小组展示修订后的时间安排。
entries.note: 通知类群发信件或备忘录可用，属半正式；结尾配 Best regards，不宜再写 Yours faithfully。

entries.en: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是为了对___表示诚挚的感谢。
entries.example: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for the warm reception you extended to me during my visit.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是为了对您在我访问期间给予的热情接待表示诚挚的感谢。
entries.note: 首段开门见山点明目的，gratitude 后接 for + 名词或动名词，比 thanks 更书面。

entries.en: I am writing to inform you that ___.
entries.example: I am writing to inform you that the meeting scheduled for Friday has been postponed to next Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是为了告知您，原定于周五的会议已推迟至下周一。
entries.note: 通知、告知类信件首段核心句；that 后接完整从句，inform 后必须先有宾语 you 再接 that。

entries.en: I am writing in response to your letter of ___ concerning ___.
entries.zh: 兹回复您___日关于___的来信。
entries.example: I am writing in response to your letter of May 5 concerning the internship programme.
entries.exampleZh: 兹回复您5月5日关于实习项目的来信。
entries.note: 回信类首段必用；in response to 后接来信，日期用 of + 日期，勿写成 in response of。

entries.en: I am writing on behalf of ___ to ___.
entries.example: I am writing on behalf of the Student Union to invite you to deliver a lecture on campus.
entries.exampleZh: 我代表学生会写信邀请您来校园做一场讲座。
entries.note: 以集体名义写信时首段使用；on behalf of 后接机构或群体，后接不定式说明目的。

entries.en: I am writing to lodge a complaint about ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是为了就___提出投诉。
entries.example: I am writing to lodge a complaint about the poor quality of the laptop I purchased last week.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是为了就我上周购买的笔记本电脑质量低劣一事提出投诉。
entries.note: 投诉信首段用；lodge a complaint about 比 complain 更正式，about 后接名词性成分。

entries.en: I would like to take this opportunity to ___.
entries.example: I would like to take this opportunity to extend my warmest congratulations on your graduation.
entries.exampleZh: 我想借此机会对您的毕业表示最热烈的祝贺。
entries.note: 适用于祝贺信、感谢信首段；后接动词原形，比 I want to 礼貌，是提分句式。

entries.en: As you may know, ___.
entries.example: As you may know, our library will be closed for renovation throughout the coming month.
entries.exampleZh: 如您所知，我们图书馆将在接下来一个月闭馆整修。
entries.note: 第二段引入背景信息；后接完整句，注意区别于 as you know it，勿混用。

entries.en: To begin with, ___.
entries.example: To begin with, it would be advisable to set aside a fixed period for revision every day.
entries.exampleZh: 首先，每天留出固定的时间复习是可取的。
entries.note: 第二段第一条理由或建议的标志语；后接完整句，正式书面，优于 firstly 与 first of all。

entries.en: In addition, ___.
entries.example: In addition, the venue should be equipped with modern facilities for the participants.
entries.exampleZh: 此外，场地应为参会者配备现代化的设施。
entries.note: 衔接并列的第二条信息；后接完整句，后接成分须与上句同类，避免与 what is more 相邻重复。

entries.en: What is more, ___.
entries.example: What is more, such an arrangement would save both time and money for all those involved.
entries.exampleZh: 更重要的是，这样的安排会为所有相关人员节省时间和金钱。
entries.note: 第二条理由的标志语，语气强于 in addition；后接完整句，注意是 what is more 而非 what's more。

entries.example: As for the fee, it can be paid in two instalments if necessary.
entries.exampleZh: 至于费用，如有需要可以分两期支付。
entries.note: 话题转移到具体细节时使用；as for 后接名词或动名词，不接完整从句，多用于第二段末。

entries.en: With regard to ___, ___.
entries.example: With regard to the deadline, I would suggest that the application be submitted before June 10.
entries.exampleZh: 关于截止日期，我建议在6月10日之前提交申请。
entries.note: 正式引用某一事项，优于 about；后接名词性成分，且注意须用 regard 单数，不用 regards。

entries.en: I would appreciate it if you could ___.
entries.zh: 如果您能___，我将不胜感激。
entries.example: I would appreciate it if you could send me the relevant materials at your earliest convenience.
entries.exampleZh: 如果您能尽早把相关材料寄给我，我将不胜感激。
entries.note: 礼貌请求的黄金句式，用于第三段；it 不可省略，could 后接动词原形，比 please 委婉。

entries.en: I would be grateful if you could ___.
entries.zh: 如果您能___，我将非常感激。
entries.example: I would be grateful if you could confirm your attendance before the end of this week.
entries.exampleZh: 如果您能在本周末之前确认出席，我将非常感激。
entries.note: 与 appreciate 句式同义但更直接；用于提出请求段，注意 grateful 后不加 it。

entries.en: I am wondering if it would be possible for you to ___.
entries.example: I am wondering if it would be possible for you to give a brief talk at our seminar.
entries.exampleZh: 我想知道您是否能在我们的研讨会上做一次简短发言。
entries.note: 极为客气的间接请求，用于邀请或求助；would be possible for you to 结构完整，勿简写。

entries.en: Would it be convenient for you to ___?
entries.example: Would it be convenient for you to meet me at three o'clock on Thursday afternoon?
entries.exampleZh: 您周四下午三点与我见面方便吗？
entries.note: 询问时间安排是否合适，多用于第二段；问句本身是疑问语气，末尾用问号。

entries.en: Could you please ___?
entries.example: Could you please forward the invitation letter to the other members of the committee?
entries.exampleZh: 能否请您把邀请函转发给委员会其他成员？
entries.note: 简洁礼貌的请求句，用于第三段；could 比 can 委婉，please 置于句中，后接动词原形。

entries.en: I hope you would not mind ___ ing.
entries.example: I hope you would not mind postponing the meeting until the following week.
entries.exampleZh: 希望您不介意把会议推迟到下一周。
entries.note: 委婉提出可能给对方带来不便的请求；mind 后必须接动名词，不可接不定式。

entries.en: Please accept my sincere apologies for ___.
entries.zh: 请接受我对___的诚挚道歉。
entries.example: Please accept my sincere apologies for failing to attend the meeting yesterday.
entries.exampleZh: 请接受我对昨天未能出席会议的诚挚道歉。
entries.note: 道歉信首段核心句，apologies 用复数；for 后接名词或动名词，不可接句子。

entries.en: I must apologize for ___.
entries.example: I must apologize for the delay in replying to your email of last Monday.
entries.exampleZh: 我必须为迟复您上周一的邮件而道歉。
entries.note: 语气直接的致歉句，用于投诉回信或道歉信首段；apologize for 后接名词性成分，不接 that 从句。

entries.en: Thank you for your generous help.
entries.example: Thank you for your generous help, without which I could never have completed the project on time.
entries.exampleZh: 感谢您的慷慨相助，没有它我绝不可能按时完成这个项目。
entries.note: 致谢信首段或结尾均可；后接名词或动名词，句末用句号，不要用感叹号堆砌。

entries.en: Your timely assistance means a great deal to me.
entries.zh: 您及时的帮助对我意义重大。
entries.example: Your timely assistance means a great deal to me and I will always bear it in mind.
entries.exampleZh: 您及时的帮助对我意义重大，我会永远铭记于心。
entries.note: 致谢信结尾升华句；主语为单数 assistance，动词用 means，勿写成 mean。

entries.en: I am deeply indebted to you for ___.
entries.example: I am deeply indebted to you for your patience and encouragement during my hardest days.
entries.exampleZh: 我对您在我最艰难的日子里给予的耐心与鼓励深怀感激。
entries.note: 高级致谢句，用于感谢信第二段；indebted to sb for sth，介词搭配固定，不可换成 with。

entries.en: I am looking forward to your early reply.
entries.example: I am looking forward to your early reply, and I thank you in advance for your assistance.
entries.exampleZh: 期待您早日回复，并提前感谢您的帮助。
entries.note: 末段结束句；to 为介词，后接名词或动名词，写成 look forward to hear 是典型失分错误。

entries.en: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
entries.zh: 期待很快收到您的回音。
entries.example: I look forward to hearing from you soon and to discussing the details in person.
entries.exampleZh: 期待很快收到您的回音，并希望能当面商讨细节。
entries.note: 结束语前最后一句；hear from sb 意为收到某人来信，动名词形式为 hearing from。

entries.en: Your prompt reply would be highly appreciated.
entries.example: Your prompt reply would be highly appreciated, as the deadline is drawing near.
entries.exampleZh: 由于截止日期临近，如蒙速复，不胜感激。
entries.note: 末段催促回复；prompt 意为及时的，主语为 reply，故用被动 would be appreciated。

entries.en: Thank you for your time and consideration.
entries.example: Thank you for your time and consideration, and I wish you a pleasant week ahead.
entries.exampleZh: 感谢您的时间与考虑，祝您本周愉快。
entries.note: 末段结束句，通用性极强；句末用句号，考场上务必留出这句作为收束。

entries.en: Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information.
entries.zh: 如需更多信息，请随时与我联系。
entries.example: Please feel free to contact me at 12345678 if you need any further information.
entries.exampleZh: 如需更多信息，请随时拨打12345678与我联系。
entries.note: 末段提供进一步联系方式；feel free to 后接动词原形，勿写成 feel free contacting。

entries.en: I would be more than happy to provide further details.
entries.zh: 我很乐意提供更多细节。
entries.example: I would be more than happy to provide further details should you require them.
entries.exampleZh: 如果您需要，我很乐意提供更多细节。
entries.note: 结尾表达合作意愿；would be more than happy to 后接动词原形，语气热情而不失正式。

entries.en: Yours sincerely,
entries.example:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
entries.exampleZh:
您真诚的，
李明
entries.note: 结束语另起一行、首字母大写、末尾加逗号；仅用于已知收信人姓名的信件。

entries.en: Yours faithfully,
entries.example:
Yours faithfully,
Li Ming
entries.exampleZh:
您忠实的，
李明
entries.note: 与 Dear Sir or Madam / To Whom It May Concern 严格配对；若称呼用了姓名则改 Yours sincerely。

entries.en: Sincerely yours,
entries.example:
Sincerely yours,
Li Ming
entries.exampleZh:
您真诚的，
李明
entries.note: 美式常用变体，语义等同于 Yours sincerely；与称呼的正式度仍需对应，末尾逗号不可省。

entries.en: Best regards,
entries.example:
Best regards,
Li Ming
entries.exampleZh:
此致问候，
李明
entries.note: 半正式结束语，适合 Dear All 的通知或备忘录；不宜与 Dear Sir or Madam 搭配。

entries.en: Cordially yours,
entries.example:
Cordially yours,
Li Ming
entries.exampleZh:
谨致问候，
李明
entries.note: 较温暖的正式结束语，用于感谢信或祝贺信；考场上优先选 Yours sincerely，更稳妥。

entries.en: Li Ming
entries.example:
Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
entries.exampleZh:
您真诚的，
李明
entries.note: 落款另起一行顶格写，只写姓名，不加逗号句号，绝不可写真实姓名或学号。

entries.en: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on ___.
entries.zh: 我写信对___致以最热烈的祝贺。
entries.example: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on your being admitted to Peking University.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是为了对您被北京大学录取致以最热烈的祝贺。
entries.note: 祝贺信首段核心句；congratulations on 后接名词或动名词，congratulations 必须用复数。

entries.en: I am writing to apply for the position of ___ advertised in ___.
entries.zh: 我写信应聘___上刊登的___一职。
entries.example: I am writing to apply for the position of interpreter advertised in yesterday's China Daily.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信应聘昨日《中国日报》上刊登的口译员一职。
entries.note: 求职信首段必用；apply for 后接职位，advertised in 后接媒体名称，勿漏介词 for。

entries.en: I am writing to seek your assistance with regard to ___.
entries.zh: 我写信是想就___寻求您的帮助。
entries.example: I am writing to seek your assistance with regard to the accommodation on campus.
entries.exampleZh: 我写信是想就校园住宿一事寻求您的帮助。
entries.note: 求助信首段；seek your assistance 比 ask for help 正式，with regard to 后接名词性成分。

entries.en: I regret to inform you that ___.
entries.example: I regret to inform you that I will be unable to attend the interview arranged for Friday.
entries.exampleZh: 我很遗憾地告知您，我将无法参加安排在周五的面试。
entries.note: 抱歉信或婉拒信首段；regret to do 表示遗憾地要做，与 regret doing（后悔做过）含义不同。

entries.en: I am afraid I will have to decline your invitation owing to ___.
entries.zh: 由于___，恐怕我不得不谢绝您的邀请。
entries.example: I am afraid I will have to decline your invitation owing to a prior engagement on that day.
entries.exampleZh: 由于当天已有约在先，恐怕我不得不谢绝您的邀请。
entries.note: 婉拒信第二段；decline 比 refuse 礼貌，owing to 后接名词性成分，不可接完整句子。
